quote.text: We cannot choose our external circumstances, but we can always choose how we respond to them.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that you cannot control every situation your children face; however, you always have the power to choose a response that cultivates resilience and teaches by example.
    • In every challenge, display gentle discipline and acceptance, guiding your children to embrace life’s uncertainties with fortitude and understanding.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, accept that external events—company crises, market shifts, or team dynamics—are beyond complete control; your virtue lies in responding with calm deliberation.
    • Embrace each situation as an opportunity to exhibit wisdom and steady resolve, inspiring those around you to navigate challenges with measured courage.
  • Product Management
    • While market trends and external feedback may be unpredictable, focus on your response by adapting strategies with clear thought and a resilient spirit.
    • Invest in fostering an agile mindset in your teams, where each setback becomes a chance to refine the product and evolve together through reflection and decisive action.
